INSERT INTO `warehouse_record`
request_id, item_id, user_id, operator_id, recipient, record_type, quantity, before_qty, after_qty, related_plot_id, related_task_id, related_fault_id, source_type, supplier, price, total_amount, record_time, status, remark,
#{requestId}, #{itemId}, #{userId}, #{operatorId}, #{recipient}, #{recordType}, #{quantity}, #{beforeQty}, #{afterQty}, #{relatedPlotId}, #{relatedTaskId}, #{relatedFaultId}, #{sourceType}, #{supplier}, #{price}, #{totalAmount}, #{recordTime}, #{status}, #{remark},
mapper.update: UPDATE `warehouse_record` SET operator_id = #{operatorId}, price = #{price}, total_amount = ROUND(quantity * #{price}, 2) WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND record_type = 1 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT wr.* FROM `warehouse_record` wr WHERE wr.request_id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM `warehouse_record` wr
WHERE wr.status = 1 AND wr.record_type IN (1, 2)
AND wi.farm_owner_id = #{ownerId} AND wi.farm_owner_id IS NOT NULL AND wi.is_deleted = 0 AND wi.status = 1
AND wr.record_type = #{recordType} ORDER BY wr.record_time DESC, wr.id DESC
